basics.label: AI Engineer — LLM Evaluation and Development
basics.summary: AI engineer building and evaluating large language models for Filipino and Southeast Asian languages (SEA-LION, SEA-HELM): benchmarks, rubric-based LLM-as-judge, synthetic data, and agentic evaluation.

work.name: AI Singapore

work.name: Ateneo de Manila University
